sources.title: Independent CPU variations and existing raw-measurement audit

claims.statement: Token is a generation unit mapped to an ID; it need not be an entire written character or word.
claims.scope: General word/subword/byte tokenization; this TinyLM uses the repository ByteTokenizer rather than a pretrained tokenizer.

evidence.supports: Words/subwords become IDs; byte-level units can represent character pieces.
This tokenizer maps each UTF-8 byte to its own ID; independently checked 字 uses three IDs.

claims.statement: Prefill processes prompt positions; cached decode computes a new query and new K/V for the added token while attending to retained K/V, and each layer retains its own cache.
claims.scope: Ordinary causal autoregressive full-context caching, as implemented here; no claim about sliding-window, chunked prefill or speculative decoding variants.

evidence.locator: Caching; Attention matrices; Cache storage implementation
evidence.supports: Stored past K/V are reused, current query attends to concatenated past/current K/V, appended per layer; cache sequence dimension grows.
Projection inputs are new positions; concat/cache/attention retain full context.
Full-context KV memory and attention work increase with output length; does not guarantee a particular wall-time slowdown on every device.

claims.statement: The fence builds an untrained TinyLM(width=8), switches eval mode, creates integer ID tensors, runs no_grad forward calls, passes per-layer cache and prints shapes; eval and no_grad serve different purposes.
claims.scope: API coverage: TinyLM/ModelConfig defaults and width, torch.tensor IDs, Module.eval, torch.no_grad, TinyLM forward cache keyword, logits/cache keys, layer/K indexing and Tensor.shape/tuple/print. This is shape inspection with forced ID5, not generated-language evidence; no backward or update.

evidence.supports: Evaluation mode is train(False), not a gradient-disable mechanism.
Disables reverse-mode gradient calculation for forward tensor results here.
Exact local defaults and forward return/cache contract.
Original fence executed successfully on CPU.
eval alone leaves grad recording active; no_grad outputs have no recorded gradient; parameters unchanged.

verification.expected: Successful forward-only fence; eval distinct from no_grad and no updates.
verification.observed: Original exit 0; eval-only logits requires_grad=true; no_grad outputs false; parameters exactly unchanged.
verification.details: No backward or optimizer was invoked; forced ID5 is not sampled from the random model.

claims.statement: Four prompt IDs yield logits (1,4,264), one added ID yields (1,1,264); first-layer K grows (1,1,4,8)→(1,1,5,8). Six prompt IDs give (1,6,264) and K lengths 6→7.
claims.scope: Axes are batch, position, vocabulary for logits and batch, KV head, retained position, per-head feature for K. Defaults one head, width=8, vocab=264, no padding/packing; all dimensions are counts, not timing units.

evidence.supports: Defaults vocab=264/head=1; logits preserve current positions and cache offset.
K reshape [B,Hkv,T,width/H] and append along retained position axis.
Actual four-position output matches each stated shape.
Executed six-position variation and hooks verifying new projection lengths=1.

verification.expected: Exact integer dimensions for four/six prompt positions and one new ID.
verification.details: width/head=8/1=8; total retained positions L+1. Old K slice remained exactly identical.
verification.tolerance: Exact integer shape equality; exact torch.equal for retained K.

claims.statement: TTFT spans request submission to the first received token and may include preprocessing, transport and queuing; it differs from a model-only prefill call. Prompt/output lengths and concurrency are comparison conditions; subsequent decode rate uses its own interval.
claims.scope: Service endpoints and metric distinctions, not a measured service TTFT or a claim about a specific server implementation. No single undocumented tokens/s denominator is endorsed.

evidence.locator: Time to First Token; End-to-End Request Latency; Inter-token Latency; Tokens Per Second
evidence.supports: TTFT includes queue/prefill/network and tokenization figure caption; ITL=(e2e−TTFT)/(output_tokens−1); lengths and concurrency affect performance and throughput definitions.

claims.statement: The existing L4 MHA record uses four Q/KV heads, the prompt with BOS for 25 input positions and 12 fixed new IDs; medians are prefill 2.421 ms, full path 29.034 ms and cached path 27.915 ms.
claims.scope: Audit of existing record at revision 48a4f3e912b483d70aee57c42c2aac226534a9a6, not new GPU measurements. GPU Python3.13.3/PyTorch2.14.1+cu126; CPU audit Python3.13.5/PyTorch2.14.1+cpu. Times characterize this prompt, model/config and method only.

evidence.supports: Recomputed all three nine-sample medians, prompt byte/BOS count, generated-ID lengths, GPU provenance and four-head config from original data.
Prompt construction and four-head MHA group; three warmups, nine synchronized measurements and median aggregation.
BOS=1 and 24 UTF-8 prompt bytes yield 25 positions.

verification.expected: 25 input positions, 12 new IDs; rounded medians 2.421/29.034/27.915 ms.
verification.details: Three independent timing arrays, each 9 samples; statistics.median equals recorded seconds exactly, multiply by1000 and round to3 decimal places. Full/cached ID lists each contain12 entries. Original architecture SHA recovered and matched.
verification.tolerance: For stated three-decimal milliseconds, absolute error ≤0.0005 ms; integer counts and recorded median seconds exact.

claims.statement: Both total generation timing paths include prefill and ignore EOS to run 12 steps, while normal heldout generation stops at EOS; fixed-cost text is not language-quality evidence and 12/total_seconds is not pure subsequent-decode throughput.
claims.scope: Exact historical benchmark loop and repository SFT evaluation contract, tested using a bounded always-EOS CPU control rather than model-score reevaluation. No training, checkpoint loading or GPU rerun.

evidence.supports: State starts None; first call includes whole prompt; loop is fixed range(tokens), with no EOS break; timed lambdas enclose entire fixed loop.
Normal SFT evaluation calls generate with tokenizer EOS and trims generated content at EOS.
Normal single-sequence generation breaks at EOS.
Exact historical loop produced12 EOS IDs with first-call length25; normal generate produced one EOS and stopped. Existing raw output contains4 EOS IDs and12 total IDs.
Subsequent decode interval excludes first-token waiting; dividing fixed count by inclusive total does not isolate that interval.

verification.expected: Cached fixed loop calls lengths [25,1×11], full loop [25…36], no EOS stop; normal generation stops on first EOS.
verification.observed: All expected call lengths/counts passed; fixed control outputs12 EOS IDs; normal outputs1 EOS ID. Original 12-ID MHA samples have4 EOS IDs.
verification.details: Only the AST-extracted original _fixed_decode method and local generate were executed against a deterministic lightweight CPU control. Raw decoded text was checked for faithful recording, not judged for language quality.

factual_accuracy.details: Each material concept/API checked against personally read primary documentation, exact helper contracts and bounded CPU executions; no claim of model language ability.

numeric_verification.details: Original4/six-position shapes exact; all27 original timing samples audited with nine-sample median and seconds→milliseconds conversion; prompt/BOS/generated counts exact.

figure_consistency.details: 16.2 references no image/SVG and asserts no displayed screen or spatial layout. The needed data axes are explicit in text; no render or screenshot was performed or claimed.

source_verification.details: Personally read official versioned HF/PyTorch documents and frozen rolling NVIDIA definitions; raw data pointers scoped; historic architecture SHA matches original provenance; source snapshots and per-claim locators retained.

limitations.details: Shapes only, forcedID5, no gradient/update or language-quality claim; full-context cache caveat; existing L4 observations separated from CPU checks; timing includes prefill, not service TTFT or pure subsequent decode TPS. No full training, GPU rerun or score reevaluation.
